name: Peripheral neuron
failures: Transection, diabetic and chemotherapy neuropathy, compression. Axons regrow, slowly and imperfectly.

see.note: Nerve conduction studies and EMG are routine.

model.note: Reinnervation of a known target is a clear goal.

reach.note: Surgically accessible at specific sites; diffuse neuropathy is not addressable.

edit.note: Surgical repair and conduits assist regrowth; no cell-level therapy.

verify.note: Conduction and function are directly measurable.

anchors: Peripheral nerve regeneration is a genuine biological capability humans retain
